metadata.environment: staging build 1.5.0-rc2, Firefox 132 and Chrome 131, gateway sandbox

bugs.title: Gift card balance goes negative when two tabs redeem the same card at once
steps: Open checkout for a $40 order in two tabs.
Pay in tab 1, then pay in tab 2 within a few seconds.
bugs.expected: The second payment uses only the $10 left on the card and charges $30 to the card.
bugs.actual: Both orders took $40 from the gift card; the Gift cards page now shows -$30.00.

proof.past: A 90-minute session on CH1: part and whole orders paid by gift card, unknown and used-up codes, and two tabs redeeming one card.
proof.results: One complete draft bug (a balance goes negative when two tabs redeem the same card, seen twice) and one incomplete note about a wrong total after removing a card. Part and whole redemptions and the error for unknown or used-up codes showed no problems in the time spent on them.
proof.obstacles: Staging was down for 20 minutes, so 31% of the session went on setup and waiting.
proof.outlook: Refunds of orders paid partly by gift card and the $500-on-$1 limit were not explored. The concurrency bug needs the bug reproducer, and the wrong-total note needs steps.
proof.feelings: Concerned about concurrent redemption: it moves real money.

handoffs.why: Complete steps, expected and actual; reproduce two near-simultaneous redemptions.
Two tabs redeeming one card is a scenario worth keeping as an automated check.
Concurrent redemption is a new risk for the giftcards area.
Gift card expiry is not specified in GIFT-7.
